PROGRAM motor_interlock
VAR_INPUT
  Start : BOOL;
  Stop : BOOL;
  EStop : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
  Motor : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
  (* No internal variables or timers are required for this logic *)
END_VAR

  (*
  Motor control logic:
  1. Latch ON with Start, Latch OFF with Stop.
  2. Stop has priority over Start.
  3. EStop (normally-closed, TRUE=healthy, FALSE=activated)
     must immediately de-energize the motor and prevent it from starting
     when activated (EStop = FALSE).
  *)
  Motor := ( (Start OR Motor) AND NOT Stop ) AND EStop;

END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM pump_ctrl
VAR_INPUT
    Demand : BOOL;
    LowLevel : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Pump : BOOL;
END_VAR

(*
The pump runs when there is demand AND the supply level is not too low.
The LowLevel condition acts as a hard override, preventing the pump from running.
*)
Pump := Demand AND NOT LowLevel;

END_PROGRAM
